logFilePath.description:
If specified, then logs will be read from the file at this path.
Otherwise, the file indicated by {Log.Profile#fromC3ServerLog} will be used.

headToTail.description:
The default behavior of LocalLogReader is to read from the end of the log file (so that the most recent entries
come first). If true, the LocalLogReader stream created will start at the head of the file and read "down".
The

limit.description: Number of lines that will be streamed from log. Use -1 to return all.

includeActionLogs.description:
By default, standard per-action {@link Log.Entry}s are omitted. To include those in the returned logs, set
`includeActionLogs` true.

NOTE: For using/parsing action logs, see {@link Log.Profile#fromC3ServerLog}.

filter.description:
If specified, this predicate will be used to filter the returned lines. Note that the `logLine` passed to the
lambda is the full log line, not just the message.
e.g. `2023-04-16T02:33:39.550Z [vert.x-worker-thread-82] ERROR Foo - bar` not just `ERROR Foo - bar`

lineContainsFilter.description: If specified, then only log lines that contain this string (case sensitive) will be returned.
